title: Telemetry
description: Edge-unit heartbeat, emitted every 5 s. Drives the live fleet view (buses moving on the 3D map), the fleet-health panel, and the bandwidth KPIs. Deliberately small: at 5 s cadence across a 6,400-bus fleet this is the highest-frequency message in the system, so every field has to earn its bytes. MQTT topic: argus/v1/{fleet}/{device_id}/tlm (QoS 0, retained)

schedule.description: Actual against GTFS scheduled progress. Route-delay estimation needs no computer vision at all, which is worth being explicit about.

delay_s.description: Signed. Positive is late. Compared against the GTFS stop_times prediction for this trip.

headway_s.description: Gap to the preceding bus on the same route. Detects bus bunching, which passengers experience as unreliability more sharply than raw lateness.

health.description: Operational state of the edge unit. A fleet of 6,400 units needs to be managed, and silent failure is the realistic failure mode: a camera fogs over and the bus quietly stops contributing.

queue_depth.description: Observations held in the store-and-forward spool. Rising depth means the uplink is degraded, not that the road got worse.

temp_c.description: SoC temperature. A sealed enclosure on a bus roof in a Bengaluru May is a real thermal-throttling risk, and throttling shows up as silently reduced inference FPS.

inference_fps.description: Achieved, not configured. The honest measure of whether the model fits the hardware.

camera_quality.description: Per-camera blur/exposure score. Catches the lens that has been dirty for three weeks.

uplink_kb_session.description: Bytes sent this session. Rolls up into the fleet bandwidth figure, which is the headline evidence for edge processing.
